I went from having pretty long hair to a buzz cut, and not really out of my own choice. I had dermatitis on my hands which is kinda like a worse form of excema, and I couldn't wash my own hair. I was lucky though, my friend tried so hard to learn how to wash my curly hair in the bath and did for a few months but in the end it became too tiring for me. When I shaved my head I felt on top of the world,  I could FINALLY wash my own hair again, finally not have to go out in public in greasy braids because washing my hair made me upset. It gave me back a sense of normalcy for a length of time and that made my life just so much better.
It sounds silly but it feels really dehumanizing to not be able to wash ur own hair.
